rationale.A: Railway-side path and Central Park path most of the way; only ~250 m in traffic (Tunnelitie, Pasilankatu); 1 light
rationale.B: Equivalent Central Park route starting via Laajasuontie; ~230 m in traffic; 1 light
rationale.C: Same corridor as A with a small variation in the park; +2 min
rationale.D: Through Ilmala on paths beside Veturitie/Ratapihantie, plus 240 m on Postisoudunkatu
rationale.E: Same Ilmala corridor as D, on the path instead of Postisoudunkatu
rationale.F: Long paths beside Hakamäentie/Matkamiehentie and an unsignalised Hakamäentie crossing
rationale.G: No unsignalised crossings, but ~1.7 km beside Hakamäentie (60 km/h) and Veturitie
rationale.H: Central Park route with a detour via Tenholantie (280 m in traffic); +6 min

notes: The fastest route is already the calm Central Park route with 1 light, so both categories merge into Fastest.
